text:
mira: Heads-up — after the RBAC rollout to staging we're seeing ~10k/sec audit events. ES indexing latency spiked and the billing dashboard shows a storage/indexing cost blip. KMS calls also ballooning per-event. Anyone on call?

jonathan: On it. Which index/pipeline is taking the bulk? staging-audit-v2? Any sample event?

mira: Yes staging-audit-v2. Sample (sanitized):
```json
{"ts":"2024-11-20T22:13:05Z","tenant_id":"t-123","actor":{"id":"u-987","role":"admin"},"action":"redact_request","payload":{"text":"credit card 4111-1111-1111-1111"},"envelope_kms":"projects/.../keys/e-1","schema_version":"2"}
```

sasha: Two quick calls: 1) we shouldn't call KMS per event for envelope unwrap on hot paths. Cache envelope DEKs and only KMS unwrap on rotate. 2) We need a schema-level opt-in for plaintext fields that require redaction before index.

ops-lead: Immediate mitigations we can flip now: enable 1s batching + bulk index size 5MB in the shipper, and flip sampling to 10% for non-critical tenants. That throttles ingress while we fix.

olivia: Cost estimate: if batching reduces write ops by 70% and sampling by 90% for sampled tenants, expect ~$8–15k/mo savings on index bill for staging-scale traffic. I'll draft numbers.

mira: Sounds good. Also note customers are starting to see audit event validation errors from schema v2 strictness — need a graceful validation failure path instead of dropping.

jonathan: Agreed. Propose: validation warnings go to a 'schema-warnings' topic and event still lands to cold-path index; only schema errors block. That reduces customer surprise.

sasha: For PII: introduce a per-tenant redaction config and a server-side canonicalizer that replaces matched patterns with stable HMAC hash (tenant-scoped) before indexing. That lets us keep a lookup-safe pointer without storing raw PII.

sec-bot: Reminder: any change that alters what customers see in audit logs needs a documented migration + consent. See compliance/gdpr-guidance. :warning:

ingest-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: staging->canary at 1729460000, rollout window 30m.

ops-lead: For longer term: consider moving audit-store to append-only object storage with offline indexing for heavy queries. Hot index only keeps metadata; full payloads live in cheaper blob store encrypted with envelope keys.

olivia: That would cut storage costs significantly, but increases query latency for deep forensic queries — flag to product.

mira: Action items: 1) @jonathan implement DEK cache + KMS unwrap fallback (priority). 2) @sasha prototype tenant-scoped HMAC redaction and redaction config. 3) @ops-lead enable batching + sampling as hot mitigation and monitor cost. 4) @olivia produce cost delta PR. 5) @mira draft customer communication and validation endpoint for schema warnings.

jonathan: I'll take DEK cache + canary tomorrow. Expect PR early morning.

sasha: Will push prototype redactor by EOD. Will include unit tests + small eval harness.

ops-lead: Flipping batching/sampling now. Rolling back if error rate >1%.

mira: Thanks — let's keep thread for playbook notes. I'll open the playbook PR and link here. :white_check_mark:
